extraction_notes: Extracted all tabulated catalyst-performance entries from Tables S3 and S5. Table S4 is a literature-comparison table and was not extracted. Figures S3, S6, and S16 contain plotted performance data, but the plotted values are not printed numerically and are too dense/ambiguous for reliable point-by-point extraction from the provided images; they were not digitized. Tables S6 and S7 also contain additional tabulated performance series for In2O3-CNT-S1, In2O3-CNT-S2, and In2O3-CNT-HT, plus repeated In2O3-CNT controls; these are not included here because of output-size limits in this response.
